title: Board
privacy: You see group figures. Who does what, you cannot see, and neither can we without a reason.
headline: Place {rank} in the pool {pool} · participation rate {rate}
level: Level 1: Rewarded visible on the screen of one browser
suppressed_change: Too small to show, or changed by fewer than 5

home.text: Open your association's dashboard from the link in your invitation email.

gate.forbidden: This dashboard is only for the board of this association.
gate.login: Log in with your board's account first.

stand.provisional_text: The standing is refreshed daily and is final after the fraud check and the sample.
stand.too_few: Your standing appears from {n} linked members.
stand.participation_note: Linked members who reached their daily goal on at least 3 days, divided by the member count.
stand.intensity: Focus time that counted (Rewarded visible on screen)
stand.intensity_note: Average per active member per day, at most 300 minutes per day.
stand.threshold_note: The threshold is an average participation rate of {threshold}.

weeks.caption: Per week
weeks.intensity: Focus time that counted per active member per day

werving.rounding: All counts are rounded to fives and per week. A figure appears only with at least {min} members in the group.
werving.empty: No members linked yet. Start with the promo kit.
werving.code_cap_note: Links above it go to Rewarded first.
werving.pending_note: Above the code cap; Rewarded checks whether they are members.
werving.bars_caption: Linked members per week, rounded to fives ({n})
werving.missing: Active members, the share in a squad, the share with a confirmed institution address or mobile number and the number of squads are added once the server provides them.

prijs.final_text: The result is final after the fraud check, the mandatory sample and the prize check.
prijs.provisional_text: Provisional until the fraud check, the mandatory sample and the prize check.
prijs.none: There is no prize (yet); the challenge runs for the honour.
prijs.main_yes: You compete: the member count has an external source.
prijs.main_no: You take part for the honour: without an external member source there is no main prize.
prijs.threshold_none: No threshold prize in this period.
prijs.threshold_value: Every association with an average participation rate of {rate} gets the threshold prize.
prijs.anchored: Members who count in the prize period
prijs.anchored_note: Only members with a confirmed institution address or mobile number count in the numerator.
prijs.earned_note: Prizes are earned with a performance known in advance, never raffled.
prijs.missing: Funder, delivery and the association card are added once the server provides them.

kwaliteit.flagged_note: Flagged sessions only count once a person has released them.
kwaliteit.anchored: Share with a confirmed institution address or mobile number
kwaliteit.explain: A flag is not a judgement. Rewarded reviews every flagged session; the board never sees who was flagged.

promo.intro: Texts, story template, poster with a QR per channel and a slide. Every QR source counts separately, so you see which channel works.
promo.promise_title: What you do and do not promise
promo.do_1: Focus together in squads, with a daily goal you choose yourself.
promo.do_2: The association takes part in a ranking on participation rate.
promo.do_3: Rewarded only counts the time the app was visible on the screen.
promo.dont_1: Do not mention amounts, money or rewards per person.
promo.dont_2: Do not promise a lottery or a raffle.
promo.dont_3: Do not say the board can see who is active.
